root_cause.rejected_path: exact Guest source-pass analysis followed by a separate formal Guest execution
root_cause.finding: The negative result measured a second cold CPython/WASI analyzer on the critical path, not intrinsic Future overhead.

semantics: Every live, non-approval Python capability projection returns a Future.
The physical call starts when Python dynamically reaches the tool call.
Using the proxy materializes it; final response encoding recursively materializes result Futures and drains unobserved Futures.
Playback and approval-gated capabilities remain outside direct Future execution.

claim: Removing the redundant cold analyzer turns the same two-call 150 ms fixture from a 196.60% slowdown into a 4.44% median speedup. Direct Future bookkeeping is small enough to retain for the paper story; the analyzer-based source-rewrite route remains rejected.
